	aov_invention_box_of_holding_visible = yes
	aov_invention_box_of_holding_unlocked = yes
}

}

}

	aov_invention_box_of_holding_available = yes

	aov_invention_box_of_holding_available = yes
}

}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_unlocked = {
	culture = { has_cultural_era_or_later = culture_era_late_medieval }
}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_available = {
	aov_invention_universal_grammarye_visible = yes
	aov_invention_universal_grammarye_unlocked = yes
}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_discovered = {
	has_variable = aov_inv_universal_grammarye
}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_active = {
	has_variable = aov_inv_universal_grammarye
	var:aov_inv_universal_grammarye = 2
}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_discoverable = {
	aov_invention_universal_grammarye_available = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_universal_grammarye }
}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_activatable = {
	has_variable = aov_inv_universal_grammarye
	var:aov_inv_universal_grammarye = 1
	aov_invention_universal_grammarye_available = yes
}
aov_invention_universal_grammarye_offered = {
	OR = { AND = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_society_1 var:aov_tech_offer_society_1 = flag:universal_grammarye } AND = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_society_2 var:aov_tech_offer_society_2 = flag:universal_grammarye } AND = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_society_3 var:aov_tech_offer_society_3 = flag:universal_grammarye } }
}

		aov_invention_clockwork_heralds_activatable = yes
		aov_invention_gnomish_spectacles_activatable = yes
		aov_invention_universal_grammarye_activatable = yes
	}
}

# A tier 3 economic invention could be activated
aov_inventions_t3_economic_activatable = {
	OR = {
		aov_invention_automaton_labourers_activatable = yes
		aov_invention_damestear_foundries_activatable = yes
		aov_invention_pathway_transmutation_activatable = yes
		aov_invention_pneumatic_post_activatable = yes
	}
}
